reason: The passage describes the opposite of collaboration. Pharaoh (the leader) commands the Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah to kill male babies born to Hebrew women. The text explicitly states the midwives 'feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them' (וַתִּירֶאןָ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶן מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם). The midwives deliberately disobey and let the babies live. When questioned by Pharaoh about their disobedience, they offer an excuse. This describes active resistance and defiance, not collaboration. The leaders and people are working against each other, not together.
